The extracted helpers keep the same evaluation order and `decorated` updates (`decorated &= depth != 0 || !token.IsPunct("}")` only clears the flag at depth 0 on `}`, as the original did), and the method drops from 27 to about 14; I couldn't build it because the source file isn't here, so this assumes the helpers' `IReadOnlyList<JsToken>`/`List<Member>` parameter types match the file's existing signatures.
